title: Format Float with Variable Precision

content.problemStatement: Write a program to accept a float value and an integer as input. The integer represents the precision. Print the float value according to the precision.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '123.4567 2' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '987.346732 3' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Accept a float number and an integer k, and print the float formatted with k decimal places.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Use dynamic precision formatting (e.g. %.*f in C or toFixed(k) in JS).

hints: In C, printf("%.*f", k, val) specifies the precision dynamically.
In Python, f'{val:.{k}f}' sets variable precision.
In JavaScript, val.toFixed(k) formats to k decimal places.
learningObjectives: Format floating-point values with dynamic precision.
Prevent precision loss in scientific and financial calculations.
